decisions.statement: A message claimed after this process started is still in flight.
A message still in flight is left alone.
A message whose transcript could not be read is left alone rather than released.
A message the seat read for itself is not released.
A message that reached the seat is not released.
Every message skipped is reported with the reason that message was skipped for.

definition: which messages a seat claimed and never consumed are released to be delivered again
